status.unsupported: The core does not provide a strategy view; the list shows as usual
status.noGroups: The config has no group probed on demand
status.stale: The strategy view was read at {{time}} and is out of date: {{error}}
status.outdated: This app is older than the core: some details are not shown

history.title: Strategy history
history.empty: Nothing to show in this period
history.truncated: Too many records: only the latest are shown
history.restartTail: what the core before recorded after its last collection is unknown
history.restartTailAt: the core before was last collected at {{time}}; what it recorded after is unknown

refresh.caughtUp: Collected up to the latest record the core had (#{{seq}})
refresh.unsupported: The core keeps no decision records
refresh.changed: The core restarted or dropped records meanwhile; the next collection goes on from there
refresh.busy: Another collection is running; try again shortly

coverage.pending: Core {{instance}} has {{count}} records not collected yet: recent changes may be missing
coverage.gapUnknown: Core {{instance}} lacks some records, time unknown
coverage.tail: What core {{instance}} recorded after its last collection is unknown
coverage.unknown: Whether the records of core {{instance}} are complete is unknown
coverage.noDisplay: Core {{instance}} provides no display (an older core): its changes are not shown
coverage.displayUnknown: Whether core {{instance}} provides a display is unknown
coverage.lost: Core {{instance}} ended with {{count}} records not saved; they can no longer be collected
coverage.tailAt: Core {{instance}} was last collected at {{time}}; what it recorded after is unknown

clear.title: 프로브 전략 기억 지우기
clear.confirm:
멤버의 장애 및 성능 저하 횟수, 우선순위 하향 및 시험 사용 상태, 트래픽 풀 장애 횟수, 신뢰도 선호 설정을 지웁니다.

노드의 현재 가용성, 제외 목록, 진행 중인 트래픽 풀 장애는 유지됩니다.

로컬 네트워크의 패킷 손실이 노드 장애로 처리되는 등 잘못된 관측으로 멤버의 우선순위가 낮아졌을 때 사용하세요.
clear.successPending: {{groups}}개 그룹의 전략 기억을 지웠습니다. 나머지 {{pending}}개 그룹은 나중에 완료됩니다.
clear.unsupported: 현재 코어는 전략 기억 지우기를 지원하지 않습니다.
clear.unconfirmed: 결과를 확인하지 못했습니다. 프록시 페이지에서 ‘Strategy history’를 열고 ‘Refresh’를 눌러 코어에서 최신 기록을 가져온 뒤, 이번 작업 시각에 전략 기억을 지운 그룹 수가 기록되어 있는지 확인하세요.
